roadmap.title: Baseline MCP Multi-Service Architecture, Weather Suite & CLI
roadmap.summary: Initialized production MCP server supporting stdio protocol, NWS weather tools, and modular registry.

roadmap.title: System Diagnostics & Real-time Health Inspector Tools
roadmap.summary: Adds hardware/OS diagnostics, disk capacity analyzer, process inspector, and network latency tool.

roadmap.title: Dynamic MCP Context Resources & System Log Streams
roadmap.summary: Implements MCP URI resources (logs://system, system://metrics, config://active) for LLM context injection.

roadmap.title: Interactive Prompt Templates & Troubleshooting Workflows
roadmap.summary: Adds structured prompt templates for incident diagnosis, automated code audits, and telemetry reporting.

roadmap.title: Enterprise Security Layer: Input Sanitization, Guardrails & Rate Limiting
roadmap.summary: Integrates path traversal defenses, shell injection filters, schema validations, and in-memory rate limiting.

roadmap.title: Comprehensive Pytest Suite & Automated Conformance Testing
roadmap.summary: Adds unit and integration test suites covering all tools, resources, error branches, and CI pipeline.

roadmap.title: Interactive Terminal MCP Client & Autonomous Agent Sandbox
roadmap.summary: Builds interactive REPL client communicating over stdio JSON-RPC with automated tool calling loop.

roadmap.title: High-Performance In-Memory Cache with TTL & Latency Telemetry
roadmap.summary: Introduces LRU/TTL caching for remote API endpoints and execution timing telemetry.

roadmap.title: Production Containerization (Docker/Compose) & Claude Desktop Integration
roadmap.summary: Provides multi-stage Dockerfile, docker-compose orchestration, and Claude Desktop/Cursor config JSON.

roadmap.title: Full Benchmark Suite, Architecture Diagrams & Release v1.0.0
roadmap.summary: Generates throughput benchmarks, comprehensive Mermaid architecture docs, and final v1.0.0 milestone tag.
